presentation.label: LOOP & FADE
presentation.summary: A live looper on one track that keeps playing through pattern changes, and a crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs.
presentation.overview: The LOOP&FADE machine turns one audio track into a looper: it records the master mix or the inputs all the time, loop by loop, on the sequencer's step grid, and a button press hands the loop playing now to the track, where it keeps playing through pattern changes, with or without trigs, at the pattern's tempo if you want. The looper is based on sumedho's RAM Machines. The crossfader puts each audio track and input in group A, group B or neither, and fades between the groups with an equal-power curve, from LEVEL on the Internal Mixer, LEVEL on the pages of chosen tracks, or a CC on FX CONTROL CH.
highlights: Catch the loop playing now with one button (FILL or UP) and keep it through every pattern change.
PICK plays the loop from the step grid with no trigs; PTCH and WARP make it follow the tempo, with or without its pitch.
An equal-power crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs; the delay and reverb sends follow it.
LEVEL becomes the fader on the Internal Mixer and on the tracks you choose; FUNC + LEVEL jumps to the middle.
usage: On an empty audio track, press FUNC + SRC, choose LOOP&FADE and confirm with YES. Press SRC again for page 2. Set MODE to CAPT, PLAY to PICK and leave MAX at 64 (four bars).
Press PLAY. The looper records MAIN in the background all the time.
At any moment hold PAGE (fill on) or press UP on the SRC page: the banner says CAPTURE, and when the loop ends it says CAPTURED and the loop plays on the LOOP&FADE track.
Change pattern. The loop keeps playing on the beat, through every pattern with LOOP&FADE on that track. Set MODE to OFF or press STOP to stop it.

access.location: FUNC + SRC (LOOP&FADE), SRC again on the looper's track (page 2), SETTINGS > CROSSFADER, LEVEL on the Internal Mixer (FUNC + LFO, 2/3)
steps: Select an audio track, press FUNC + SRC, scroll to LOOP&FADE and confirm with YES twice.
On the looper track's SRC page, press SRC again for page 2: MODE, MAX, SRCE, RLEV, BTN, GLOB, PLAY and LOOP.
Press SETTINGS and go down to CROSSFADER, the last row, then YES: groups for TRACK 1-8 and INPUT L/R with LEFT and RIGHT, FADER CC and FADER ON.
Press FUNC + LFO twice for the Internal Mixer: LEVEL moves the fader, shown at the lower left.

controls.name: FUNC + SRC
controls.doc: Choose LOOP&FADE (the looper) for an audio track and confirm with YES. On its SRC page, push D to open the loop in the stock trim editor.

controls.name: Page 2: A — MODE
controls.doc: OFF, ONCE (arm, record the next loop, keep it) or CAPT (records all the time; capture the loop playing now). For the whole unit, saved on the +Drive.

controls.name: Page 2: B — MAX
controls.doc: The loop length in steps: 1, 2, 4 … 128. A loop holds up to 33 s.

controls.name: Page 2: C — SRCE
controls.doc: What is recorded: MAIN (before the master compressor), IN L, IN R or IN LR.

controls.name: Page 2: E — BTN
controls.doc: The capture button: FILL (fill mode on), UP (on the the looper SRC pages) or BOTH.

controls.name: Page 2: F — GLOB
controls.doc: The loop track's parameters that stay the same in every pattern: OFF (stock), SND (delay and reverb sends), FLT (also the filter page), AMP (also the amp page), ALL (also the SRC page and the LFO).

controls.name: Page 2: G — PLAY
controls.doc: TRIG: the track's trigs end each loop and play it. PICK: the module plays the loop on the step grid, no trigs needed. PTCH: PICK that follows the tempo like a record. WARP: PICK that follows the tempo at its own pitch.

controls.name: Page 2: H — LOOP
controls.doc: Shows the looper's state (OFF, WAIT, ARM, REC, LOCK, RDY, LOOP, CAPT, NRAM) and the loop's progress.

controls.name: SETTINGS > CROSSFADER
controls.doc: Each track and input in group A, B or – (neither); FADER CC (a CC number on FX CONTROL CH, or OFF); FADER ON (the tracks whose pages make LEVEL the fader, toggled with trig keys 1-16). Saved for the whole unit on the +Drive.

controls.name: LEVEL (fader pages)
controls.doc: The crossfader, 0 (group A) to 127 (group B), equal-power. Turns as a stock knob: pushed for big steps, FUNC + LEVEL jumps to the middle, then to the end. Pushing LEVEL alone there does nothing.

limitations: Built for OS 1.54 only, with Core 2.1 and Machine Pages.
Not beside RAM Machines (it replaces it) or Digi Health (FAST AUDIO patches the same audio routines).
A kit with RAM Machines' RAM-R1 or RAM-P1 does not turn into LOOP&FADE; choose the machine again.
The looper takes 4 MB of sample memory for the take and 8 MB more for the loop buffers in ONCE or CAPT; with the memory full, page 2 shows NRAM and retries every 3 s.
The take and loops are lost at power-off or project load; page 2's and the crossfader's settings are saved for the whole unit, not per project or pattern.
One mono loop at a time. A small click can be heard at the end of each take.
Changing the machine on the loop track discards the loop.
With an Overbridge instance open (standalone or plugin) the unit gets slow; closing the instance ends it. Not yet compared with stock.
Known bug: changing PLAY mode while the loop plays restarts the loop mid-way.

load.display: Adds 1.5% average idle and 5.7% average (5.7% worst block) at its heaviest, of an audio block over stock (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.54, Core 2.1, Machine Pages, demo pattern playing; 3,000 blocks with the MCF5441x timing model at 250 MHz. Without the module 60.3% mean, 62.0% worst block; with it idle 61.8% and 63.5%; looper in CAPT playing a loop in WARP, GLOB ALL, all ten channels on the crossfader: 66.0% and 67.7% (PICK: 64.5%, 66.2%). Loop buffers (4 MB, 8 MB more in ONCE or CAPT) come from sample memory. Not a hardware measurement; the unit slows down with an Overbridge instance open (TESTING.md).

hardware.summary: draadpiraat flashed LF03 (Core 2.1, Machine Pages and this module alone) on their Digitakt I, OS 1.54, and ran the twelve-point checklist over two hours or more. Passed: CAPT and ONCE capture with FILL and UP; the loop playing on through every pattern with the looper machine on that track; PTCH and WARP following tempo changes; GLOB keeping the sends; the trim editor from push D; crossfader groups, LEVEL on the Internal Mixer and on FADER ON tracks, LEVEL push; the fader CC; settings after a power cycle; a long session without problems.
limitations: Changing PLAY mode while the loop plays restarts the loop mid-way (known bug).
With an Overbridge instance open the unit lags; stock 1.54 was not compared.
Firmware was not read back from the device; the build is identified by its SysEx hash.

tests.summary: Author hardware (Digitakt I, OS 1.54, LF03 with Core 2.1 and Machine Pages alone, 2+ hours): the looper's modes, pattern changes, PTCH/WARP, GLOB, the trim editor, the crossfader, FADER ON, the fader CC and settings after a power cycle all passed. Known: changing PLAY mode mid-play restarts the loop; an open Overbridge instance makes the unit lag. Emulator checks and load in TESTING.md.
